<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subrogation" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subrogation">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CollectionCase" name="Case for collection"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurer" name="Insurer" processRef="Process_Insurer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CollectionAgency" name="Collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request" sourceRef="SendTask_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" sourceRef="Participant_Insurant" targetRef="Catch_InsurantDisagrees"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CollectionCase" name="Case forwarded" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardCollection" targetRef="Participant_CollectionAgency"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insurer" name="Subrogation recourse handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SubrogationInfo" name="Information on possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Recourse possible?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoRecourse" name="Case closed (no recourse)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to insurant" messageRef="Msg_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateReminder" name="Create reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitInsurant" name="Await insurant response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BookPayment" name="Book payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Paid" name="Case closed (paid)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_InsurantDisagrees" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disagreement" messageRef="Msg_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning of insurant">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurantRight" name="Insurant right?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InsurantRight" name="Case closed (insurant right)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DeadlineReached" name="Disagreement deadline reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Deadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CollectionMerge" name="Forward to collection needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ForwardCollection" name="Forward case to collection agency" messageRef="Msg_CollectionCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Collection" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SubrogationInfo" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="EndEvent_NoRecourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="SendTask_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_PaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_CreateReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_CreateReminder" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitInsurant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitInsurant" targetRef="Catch_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitInsurant" targetRef="Catch_InsurantDisagrees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitInsurant" targetRef="Catch_DeadlineReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Catch_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="EndEvent_Paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Catch_InsurantDisagrees" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_InsurantRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="EndEvent_InsurantRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="Gateway_CollectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Catch_DeadlineReached" targetRef="Gateway_CollectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_CollectionMerge" targetRef="SendTask_ForwardCollection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardCollection" targetRef="EndEvent_Collection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
